conflicts.description: Solidus and liquidus temperatures of ERBOCo-1 are ~20–40 °C higher than previously published values (1318 °C and 1400 °C). The reason remains unclear; possible explanations include as-cast vs heat-treated measurement, polycrystalline vs single-crystalline samples, arc-melted from raw elements vs master melt, and different heating rates (10 °C/min vs 5 °C/min).
